before: Native documents had no independent review group store initialized before room bootstrap.
after: Preparation creates a bounded application-owned custom XML group store before editor or room creation. Independent immutable group records retain native Word addresses; removal reserves identities for undo. Native stories, imported styles, and unrelated custom parts retain their content and bytes.
reason: The private adapter reuses existing custom XML package operations and byte-preserving initialization. Group-only room fixtures use the same initializer as full application preparation. Two real sessions verify independent record creation and removal, peer-preserving undo/redo, owner deletion, geometry, and save/reopen. No native Word attributes, published APIs, provider implementation, shared operation formats, or version fields change. R14 still owns replacement of its earlier native-attribute persistence prototype. No published changeset applies.
